title: Fill Frequency 0 % shifts the needle 0 mm per row
description: A 40 × 40 mm fill at 0° with 4 mm stitches: each row's needle points are shifted from the previous row's by the Frequency (as a share of the stitch length), ±2 % of the stitch length.

references.make: On a 100 × 100 mm Design Page draw a 40 × 40 mm square at (10, 10) mm. Line sewing off; region sew type Fill Stitch, Direction 0°, stitch length 4.0 mm, Frequency 0 %, other attributes default. Save with Save As as PES (PE-DESIGN 11's default PES version) under the file name given, and record the PE-DESIGN version, the date, the operating system and every setting you changed in compat/reference/MANIFEST.json (see docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md).

measurements.evidence: audit item 15: shift = frequency ±2 % of the stitch length
region_compat: more than 50 rows of needle points
